title: Fighting from the Steadfast
description: The fight between Rey and Kylo Ren escalates. Ren, growing progressively more impatient, wants to know where Rey is hiding. lightsabers clash until finally a strike between them shatters the pedestal that holds the incinerated helmet of Darth Vader. Vader's fearsome mask falls to ground at the foot of Kylo Ren, and it becomes perfectly clear where Rey has been along.
